p. 123, section 3 and notes 80–82: Grimhild’s property, intention, request for the charter and first place in the witnesses. The study follows the January dating.
Section Childerich III, pp. 209–211, especially points b–f: the Soissons capitulary, the Wissembourg charter, the ninth regnal year on the Attigny original and the change of dynasty.

note.de: Grimhild schenkte dem Kloster Besitz. Sein Urkundenbuch bewahrt eine Abschrift ihrer Verfügung mit der Datierung nach Karlmann und Pippin.
note.en: Grimhild donated property to the monastery. Its cartulary preserves a copy of her grant, dated by Carloman and Pippin.
